title: Nuevo Laredo Offers Free Vasectomies; Registration Opens Nov. 25 at 12 Clinics
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal government announced a free vasectomy campaign for men who have decided not to have more children, with registration Nov. 25-26 at 12 Clínicas UNE across the city.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo, led by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, has announced a free vasectomy campaign for men who have decided not to have more children, in coordination with Health District V for Wellbeing.

Registration will take place Wednesday, Nov. 25, and Thursday, Nov. 26, from 8 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. at 12 Clínicas UNE located in different sectors of the city. The surgeries will be performed later at the Hospital General de Nuevo Laredo, with dates to be announced once registration closes.

To register, men need to provide their name, age, address and phone number, and present a copy of their official INE identification. No prior medical studies are required to complete the process.

The mayor said the campaign is meant to bring free health services closer to residents and to encourage men to take an active, responsible part in family planning decisions, describing family planning as a shared responsibility.

A vasectomy is a permanent contraceptive method that prevents sperm from reaching semen. According to the municipal announcement, the procedure does not affect the production of male hormones or sexual performance.

The 12 registration sites are:

  • Valles de Paraíso: Calle Nogales, between Durazno and Ciruelos, colonia Valles del Paraíso
  • Los Olivos 2: Avenida Vencedor, between Canadá and Diploma, colonia Los Olivos
  • Los Toboganes: Calle Artículo 6, between Prometeo and Artículo 123, colonia Los Toboganes
  • El Campanario: Río Grijalva and Río Churubusco, colonia El Campanario
  • Santa Cecilia: Quirino Mendoza #4815, colonia Santa Cecilia
  • Nueva Era: Circuito Jesús González Bastién #252
  • La Joya: Victoria #8816, between 6 de Abril and Esmeralda
  • Valles de Anáhuac: Calle 16 and Avenida 9
  • Unión del Recuerdo: Avenida La Cruz #707, colonia Unión del Recuerdo
  • El Progreso: Monte Olimpo, between Esfinge e Himeneo, colonia El Progreso
  • Palmares: Calle Guanajuato and Tamaulipas, fraccionamiento Palmares
  • Primero de Mayo: Calle San Jacinto, between Santa Emiliana and San Eliseo, colonia Primero de Mayo

The municipal government invited interested men to visit any of the clinics to register and receive guidance about the procedure.

Source: Gobierno Municipal de Nuevo Laredo, Nov. 22, 2026.
